items.title: 3 AI Chip Stocks Investors Are Eyeing As China Revenue Risk Comes Into Focus
items.summary: Washington’s latest plan to clamp down harder on Chinese access to advanced AI chips has jolted global markets and put a fresh spotlight on where AI hardware revenue really comes from. Some investors are now hunting for opportunities in companies whose AI and data center ambitions appear less tied to China.
